caption: Large language models also have numbers called weights. Those weights are adjusted during training to improve predictions; they aren't counts of word pairs.

caption: A few tips. Start on any page you like. A full stop is followed by whatever comes next, even over the page. Skip the speech marks. And a new word always gets a new row and a new column.
